candidates.author: HuiW86
candidates.title: feat(assistant): OpenAI-compatible summaries for user-configured services
candidates.snippet:
Refs #12 #68 #71

第④步（M2 里不依赖后端的一半）的核心：用户自配 AI 服务（`features.md` X11）和纪要（G1）。只有 `ReviveKit` 里的逻辑和测试，**还没有界面和接线**。由子代理编写，我检查后并入，并补了一条静态检查。

## 改动

- **新模块 `Assistant`**（唯一允许联网的模块）
  - `ChatClient`：兼容 OpenAI 的 `/chat/completions` 客户端；没有密钥时不发 Authorization；错误分为未配置、HTTP 错误、回复看不懂、连不上；去掉 `<think>` 块
  - `Summarizer`：纪要生成。超过 9000 字的文字稿先按句切成约 6000 字的段，各压成要点再整体整理；回复容错解析（取首尾大括号之间、字段裁剪、未知场景归为其他、缺摘要报错）；另有不用模型的关键词粗整理
  - `RecordingScene`：10 种场景及其定义、栏目、关键词
  - `ServiceConfig` / `ServicePreset`：12 家对话服务、4 家转写服务的地址；打印配置时隐藏密钥
  - `KeychainKeyStore`：密钥存钥匙串；另有测试用的内存版
- **`Library`**：迁移 `v6` 新增 `summary` 表（随录音删除）；

## Pipeline (already in base, completed here)

candidates.title: I think local LLMs are great for tinkerers, and with quantization can run on most modern…
candidates.snippet: I think local LLMs are great for tinkerers, and with quantization can run on most modern PCs. I am not comfortable sending over my personal data over to OpenAI/Anthropic, so I've been playing around with https://github.com/PromtEngineer/localGPT/ , GPT4All, etc. which keep the data all local. Sliding window chunking, RAG, etc. seem more sophisticated than the other document LLM tools, so I would love to try this out if you ever add the ability to run LLMs locally!
